explanation.note: Rubric v2: explanation_final_score = base rubric gated on perturbation_localized (unlocalized explanations score 0.0). mean_explanation_final_score_over_all_perturbed counts missed detections and judge errors as 0.0.

metrics_caveat: The task description assumed a single-class ground truth (all statements incorrect), under which precision would be trivially 1.0 and F1 degenerate, leaving recall (= detection rate) as the meaningful metric. The ACTUAL dataset is two-class and nearly balanced (is_perturbed: 246 true / 240 false), so accuracy, precision, recall, and F1 (positive class = perturbed/incorrect statement) are all meaningful here. Recall over the perturbed class still equals the error-detection rate.
